Comfortable Accommodations: Sea You Surfers Nest! Hello to waves in a minute walk in Kumbalgama offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private entrances, and balconies. Each room includes a work desk, free toiletries, and a wardrobe.

Dining Experience: The hotel features a family-friendly restaurant serving Asian and European cuisines in a traditional and modern ambience. Guests can enjoy local specialities, warm dishes, juice, and fruits for breakfast.

Amenities and Services: Guests benefit from free WiFi in public areas, a 24-hour front desk, and free on-site private parking. Additional facilities include a terrace, garden, and paid airport shuttle service.

all_booking.title: Very nice stay
all_booking.positive: I had a very pleasant stay at this place. For the paid price, the room were absolutely good value and met my expectations. Outside, there is a lovely and well-maintained patio area, which is very nice to relax in. Ashley, the owner, is truly fantastic, very kind, attentive, and always ready to help with anything you might need. He really makes you feel welcome and well taken care of.
all_booking.negative: Since I was on the ground floor the room was a little dark. Also, my bathroom was located outside the room. Although it was supposed to be for private use, occasionally it seemed to be used by others as well

all_airbnb.text:
We had a great stay! Ashly was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and very accomodating. The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is amazing, just steps away from the sea and restaurants. 
We would definitely recommend staying here!

all_airbnb.author: Molly Jayne
all_airbnb.text: Amazing location in Midigama. Great place to stay, would recommend

all_airbnb.author: Florentine
all_airbnb.text: Sehr angenehmer ruhiger Aufenthalt, schönes Zimmer und gute Lage zum surfen. Nette Restaurants direkt um die Ecke oder in der Küche schnell was selbst zubereiten ist auch kein Problem. Würde wieder kommen :-)

all_airbnb.author: Raul
all_airbnb.text: It was a nice place to stay. Would recommend to go there.

all_airbnb.author: Sanna
all_airbnb.text: Fantastic place for exploring Midigama. Peaceful location, but walking distance or short tuk tuk ride to wonderful beaches, surf sports and nice restaurants. The accomodation had everything you need for a comfortable stay: good bed & pillow, space enough in the room to get your things out of the bag, hot water and en suite bathroom. I was partially working during my stay and found the setup in the outside area perfect for remote working: good wifi, comfortable desk & chair and even universal socket adapters outside! Communication with Ashly was always very quick and positive. Would definitely return!

all_airbnb.author: Niamh
all_airbnb.text: We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and price! Private balcony outside of rooms. The host is extremely responsive and helpful. Let us check in sooner, was able to book an additional night, recommend where to get laundry done & sorted an airport transfer for us! Highly recommend staying here

all_airbnb.author: Mareike
all_airbnb.text:
Ashly und sein Bruder waren sehr aufmerksame & freundliche Gastgeber. Ich wurde kostenlos von meiner vorigen Unterkunft abgeholt. Mir wurde bei allen Fragen und Problemen sehr schnell geantwortet und geholfen. Ashly wohnt mit im Haus und man teilt sich die Küche mit ihm und den anderen Gästen. Deshalb fühlt sich der Aufenthalt an, wie als wohne man bei einer Gastfamilie. Die Lage ist Top, nur ein paar Schritte bis zum Meer, Restaurants und Surfshops. 
Ich hatte das Zimmer mit Klimaanlage, die eine Tür hin zu einem schönen großen Balkon hat. Nicht alle Zimmer haben diesen Zugang. Gefreut hätte ich mich noch über kostenloses Trinkwasser und ein Regal oder Schrank im Zimmer. Wer mit hohen Temperaturen zurechtkommt, sitzt sicher gerne auf dem Balkon. Wer es nur im Kühlen aushält und deshalb im Zimmer bleibt, findet es vielleicht ein bisschen dunkel (keine großen Tageslichtfenster aus Glas) sondern vergitterte offene Fenster mit Fensterläden, die man wegen dem AC geschlossen hält.

all_airbnb.author: Hannah
all_airbnb.text: Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt! Die Lage war super alles in Laufnähe erreichbar: Surfen, Strand, Cafés und Restaurants. Ashly war immer bemüht und hat uns bei allem unterstützt!

reviews.quotes_note: All 8 Booking reviews (ReviewList GraphQL the page itself calls) and all 10 Airbnb reviews (listing 1508895627217411616, the page's own reviews API) were read; every one is in all_booking / all_airbnb verbatim. Two Booking reviews (Szebi, Yulia: 10/10) have no text. None has an owner reply. Observation, not an accusation: the two earliest Booking reviews (Dona and Thushan, both New Zealand, one-night solo stays in Oct 2025, both 10/10) and Dona's 'We'll definitely Sea You again' pun read like friends of the house; prefer the 2026 Airbnb quotes (Sanna, Niamh, Kenza) when choosing testimonials.

critical_themes.theme: HOST/BUSINESS CONDUCT — booking mix-up: part of a group turned away, refund refused
examples: Camilla, United Kingdom (Booking, stay 2026-01-01 to 01-04, 5/10, review 9e7670457ab0f400): 'there was a muddle with our booking and part of our group had to stay elsewhere (in not a nice place which we only stayed in for one night and they refused to refund us for other two nights)The issue was either a booking.com issue or the property it is unclear to us which. We had had confirmation emails etc  but the place was full…I was travelling with my daughter and so we ended up in different places which was upsetting.'
critical_themes.note: Flagged high under the run's rule (anything about host conduct). It is an overbooking/refund complaint, not a personal-safety or harassment allegation; the guest herself is unsure whether Booking or the property was at fault. No owner reply. Never quoted or paraphrased on the site.

critical_themes.theme: HOST CONDUCT — owner unaccommodating and stingy
examples: Daniel, Switzerland (Booking, stay 2026-02-03, 6/10, review 9bdf7dd66e421455, in French): 'Nous avons pas apprécié le propriétaire peu arrangeant et agréable. Il comptait chaque centime et nous nous sommes pas senti très accueilli.' (we did not like the owner, not accommodating or pleasant; he counted every cent and we did not feel welcome)

Two host/business-conduct complaints (Camilla: overbooking and refused refund; Daniel: unfriendly, penny-counting owner) are flagged severity high under this run's rule and need a human glance; neither is a safety allegation. images_note: 82 distinct photos kept from 198 gallery files (Booking 45; Airbnb listing 1508895627217411616: 62; Airbnb listing 1793988904511877292: 91 incl. re-uploads). 116 re-uploads of the same photo across the three listings were dropped (24×24 grey-thumbnail correlation ≥ 0.985, every merged group has identical original pixel sizes, and no photo repeats on the contact sheets); the kept copy is Booking's where one exists, and the others are listed under also_on. Licence: all 82 business-owned (property/host uploads to its own listings). Apart from two lower-resolution courtyard/veranda shots (img-046 1280×714 original, img-047 914×1280) and two HDR phone-style balcony shots (img-076, img-077), they are one consistent professional set uploaded to Booking on 2025-09-28/29 (originals 3000–5568 px). No stock or third-party image found, and no identifiable person in any photo (no guests, staff or children). Flags: img-001 shows the phone number on the sign; img-046 shows a CCTV camera. Pixel sizes as stored: long edge ≤ 2000 px. 27 landscape, 55 portrait. 26 landscape at ≥ 1920 px wide: img-002, 003, 004, 006, 007, 009, 012, 015, 017, 022, 039, 041, 045, 051, 053, 055, 057, 059, 060, 071, 072, 074, 076, 077, 080, 082. Of those, the outdoor ones are img-003 (upstairs balcony, green table, palms), img-007 and img-074 (green table on the red-oxide terrace), img-045 (balcony, carved chairs), img-071 (courtyard bench with garden), img-076 and img-077 (upstairs balconies over the palms, HDR phone look). No photo shows the house from the street, the sea, the beach or a surf break; the 'exterior' set is the sign (img-001, portrait), the courtyard (img-046, 071), a stair (img-042) and verandas. Strongest: the mint-green four-poster rooms with teal throws (img-002, 012, 015, 017, 022), the surfboard rack (img-034 portrait, img-072 night), the surfboard outdoor shower (img-036), the carved doors and masks (img-027, 035), and the lounge with surfboards (img-004). Weak: few landscapes outside, nothing of the water.
videos_note: The business publishes no video: no website, no YouTube/Vimeo channel, no Instagram or Facebook found; Booking, Agoda and both Airbnb listings hold stills only. YouTube searches (yt-dlp ytsearch10 'Sea You Surfers Nest Midigama', ytsearch6 'Surf sick Midigama homestay') return only generic Midigama surf clips from other channels (Surfers of Sri Lanka, Lotus Surf Camp, …), none of this house. No hero video: the first screen leads with a photograph.

same_address_neighbour.comparison: Different names, different phone numbers (+94742432996 on Surf sick's Google listing vs +94715880052 on Sea You's sign), different Booking listings and postcodes (81000 vs 81700), different languages (EN+FR vs EN), different check-in times, different Google categories (Homestay vs Bed & breakfast). Their photos show different buildings: Surf sick's are phone snapshots of a timber-ceilinged room, a shade-sail garden with a green mesh fence, a dog, food and the beach; Sea You's are a professional set of a white two-storey house with mint-green four-poster beds, carved doors and balconies — no room, wall or object appears in both sets. Surf sick listed on Booking eleven months after Sea You. They share the street number '151 Weliwaththa Rd', which in this area is likely a lane/plot number used by neighbouring houses. Nothing public links the two hosts; a family or landlord connection cannot be ruled out from public material.
